name: Alisha Gupta
role: Public Health Specialty Registrar and NIHR Academic Fellow
researchKeywords: academic public health, Deep End primary care, workforce sustainability
bio: Dr Alisha Gupta, BMBS is a Public Health Specialty Registrar and NIHR Academic Clinical Fellow, following completion of the Specialised Foundation Programme in the North East from 2023 to 2025.
researchFocus: Alisha works in academic public health as part of the North East and North Cumbria Deep End Research Team and the Health Inequalities Team.
